name: Loving Memories
source:
Loving Memories is a visual novel about the relationship formed between two women, one an elf named Elin who has a thing for love and wishes to experience a romantic relationship and Neha, the deity of love who visits her frequently.

Experience key moments of their relationship to see how it evolves through time and see if it turns to something else, or not.

[From [url=https://naranjitadev.itch.io/loving-memories]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《爱的回忆》是一部关于两个女人之间关系的视觉小说，其中一个是一位名叫艾琳的精灵，她热爱爱情并希望体验一段浪漫的关系，而妮哈则是经常拜访她的爱神尼哈。

体验他们关系中的关键时刻，看看它是如何随着时间的推移而演变的，看看它是否会变成其他东西。

[来自[url=https://naranjitadev.itch.io/loving-memories]itch.io[/url]]
